summary: Narrow-scope retest of the 2 open items from iteration_6: (1) Sharing & Permissions round-trip — RETESTED WITH FRESH LOGIN + NETWORK CAPTURE, CONFIRMED FIXED. (2) Received-transaction full lifecycle under Amina Yusuf's actor context — creation now succeeds (previously blocked entirely by 0 beekeeper options), but a NEW blocking bug was found: newly created Received transactions are inserted with status 'Approved' immediately instead of 'Pending', so the Approve/Reject UI (which only renders when status==='Pending') is never reachable through the normal creation flow. Could not complete the Approve/Reject-with-reason steps as a result.

critical.endpoint: supabase insert into transactions (via useCreateTransaction, direct client insert, no explicit status field set)
critical.issue: New Received transactions are created with status='Approved' (and their corresponding raw-material stock row is created immediately) instead of status='Pending'. Verified directly: created a Received transaction (Kwara Central / Musa Ibrahim / Royal Jelly / 50kg / Conventional standard) — TransactionDetail page showed the 'Approved' badge and NO 'not yet approved' pending banner immediately after creation, and /stocks/raw-material already showed a new 'Batch received from Musa Ibrahim' Royal Jelly 50kg row. This means the entire Approve/Reject workflow (transaction-approve, transaction-reject, reject-reason, reject-comment, reject-confirm) is dead/unreachable UI — a Received transaction can never be in a state where those buttons render, since TransactionDetail.jsx only shows the approve/reject banner `if (tx.direction === 'Received' && tx.status === 'Pending')`. Root cause is almost certainly a Supabase table default or trigger on `transactions.status` set to 'Approved' instead of 'Pending' (the frontend insert in useCreateTransaction never sets a status field itself), or a trigger that both defaults status AND creates the stock row on INSERT rather than on approval.

minor.issue: Selecting a beekeeper not flagged for the chosen Standard correctly rejects with a clear toast 'Failed to record transaction — This beekeeper is not flagged for the Sustainable standard - transaction rejected'. This validation itself works correctly, but the beekeeper combobox is NOT filtered by the selected Standard on the frontend (same 2 beekeepers show for every Standard choice), so users can pick an invalid combination and only find out after submitting. Minor UX gap, not a hard bug.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot reach the Pending state via UI at all (see backend_issues.critical above) — transaction-approve/transaction-reject buttons, reject-reason/reject-comment/reject-confirm dialog were code-reviewed and look correctly wired to useApproveTransaction/useRejectTransaction, but could not be exercised end-to-end because every newly created transaction already shows 'Approved'.

action_items: PRIORITY 1: Fix the transactions.status default/trigger in Supabase so new Received transactions insert as 'Pending', not 'Approved' — this is blocking the entire approval workflow feature end-to-end for real users, not just this test pass.

Confirm intended behavior for stock creation: should the raw-material stock batch be created at transaction INSERT time (current behavior) or only on Approve (current UI/copy implies the latter, e.g. 'not yet approved' banner text)? If stock should only appear after Approve, that trigger also needs to move.
Sharing & Permissions bug from iteration_6 is CONFIRMED FIXED — no further action needed; do not re-test unless a regression is suspected.

Optional/minor: filter the Beekeeper combobox on ReceiveStockForm by the selected Standard (or at least the beekeeper's own certified standard) to prevent the guaranteed-to-fail submit currently possible.

useTransactions.js useCreateTransaction(): does not set a `status` field on insert at all, relying entirely on the DB default — this is the correct client-side pattern IF the DB default is right, but confirms the bug is server-side (Supabase table/trigger), not a frontend logic error. No frontend code change needed; needs a Supabase migration/trigger fix.
TransactionDetail.jsx correctly gates the pending banner and Approve/Reject buttons on tx.status === 'Pending' — this logic is correct, it's just never satisfied given the DB-side bug.

rca_of_the_issue: Transactions.status bug: useCreateTransaction (frontend) never sets a status value on insert, so whatever the Supabase table's column default (or an AFTER INSERT trigger) does determines the initial status. Since every transaction I created came back as 'Approved' with its stock already created, the DB-side default/trigger is almost certainly set to 'Approved' (possibly a leftover from when Send/Processing-style auto-approval logic was applied broadly, since the code comments in useTransactions.js note 'Send appears to be immediately Approved at creation' — that same default may have been mistakenly applied to Received transactions too, which per the UI/copy ('not yet approved' banner) and the whole Approve/Reject feature's existence are clearly meant to start as Pending).
